en.topic_title: China expels generals accused of graft from Communist Party: state media

zh.topic_title: China expels generals accused of graft from Communist Party: state media

en.topic_title: China expels generals accused of graft from Communist Party: state media
en.topic_summary:
China expelled two high-ranking military officers from the ruling Communist Party on Monday, state media reported, months after it was announced they were being investigated for “serious violations of the law”.



Zhang Youxia in a 2023 meeting with Russian president Vladimir Putin. Photo: Kremlin.



One of them, Zhang Youxia, held the position of the more senior of two vice chairmen on the Central Military Commission (CMC), making him China’s highest-ranked general.



Howeve
